name: Tabitha/Dorcas
title: The Compassionate Disciple
summary: Tabitha, also called Dorcas in Greek, was a disciple in Joppa known for her good deeds and acts of charity to the poor. She fell ill and died, but was raised from the dead by the apostle Peter, leading many to believe in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Known for Good Deeds
keyEvents.description: Tabitha was full of good deeds and acts of mercy. She made clothing for widows and helped those in need in Joppa.

keyEvents.title: Illness and Death
keyEvents.description: Tabitha fell ill and died. The disciples washed her body and laid her in an upper room.

keyEvents.title: Peter Is Summoned
keyEvents.description: The disciples in Joppa heard that Peter was nearby in Lydda, so they sent two men to bring him quickly.

keyEvents.title: Widows' Testimony
keyEvents.description: When Peter arrived, the widows showed him tearfully all the tunics and cloaks that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.

keyEvents.title: Raised from the dead
keyEvents.description: Peter told everyone to leave. He knelt down and prayed, then said to her, 'Tabitha, get up!' She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.

keyEvents.title: Many come to faith
keyEvents.description: News of this miracle spread throughout Joppa, and many came to believe in the Lord.
